scripts.build: prisma generate --schema Db/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema Db/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" Db/prisma/seed.ts && next build
scripts.setup: prisma generate --schema Db/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma migrate dev --name init --schema Db/prisma/schema.prisma && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" Db/prisma/seed.ts
